entries.what: Walks to Flats High along Vinca; at lunch by the B wing planters Brianna announces her breakup with Tyler and accuses Dulce of leaking it to Karina, while Sienna backs her up.
entries.outcome: Brianna stops speaking to Karina and glares at Dulce; Sienna starts screenshotting chats.

entries.what: After school Dulce tells her side to the assistant, then changes the subject to a caption for a taco photo.
entries.outcome: Deflects with a joke instead of finishing the conversation.

entries.what: Eats dinner in Marisol Gardens unit 114 with her mom Yesenia and is home before the 9:30 curfew.
entries.outcome: Says nothing about the fight at school.

entries.what: Skips the planters and eats lunch in Ms. Tolentino's room B12 with Karina and Eli, who shares notes from chem.
entries.outcome: Has a new lunch spot and a small new circle.

entries.what: Third-period chemistry with Ms. Tolentino; Dulce does the mole calculations quickly beside Karina.
entries.outcome: Finishes the math fast and puts off the written part.

entries.what: Takes the walk home alone, then does homework in the small bedroom by the laundry wall.
entries.outcome: Phone battery dies mid-evening.

entries.what: Finds she was removed from the 'las 4 fantásticas' chat and Karina adds her to a new chat, 'lab rats', with Eli.
entries.outcome: Joins 'lab rats' and asks the assistant whether to request to be re-added.

entries.what: Sees Brianna post a vague close-friends story about fake friends and Sienna send screenshots around.
entries.outcome: Stays quiet and doesn't reply.

entries.what: Eats B12 lunch again, then goes home to eat dinner.
entries.outcome: Laughs a little in the new chat that night.

entries.what: Walks to school and eats lunch in B12 with Karina and Eli.
entries.outcome: Normal routine, tension unresolved.

entries.what: Wants to smooth things over with both sides and drafts two texts, one to Brianna and one to Karina, each saying she's not on anyone's side.
entries.outcome: Asks which version sounds less fake and holds off sending.

entries.what: Picks up the weekend shift schedule from Efraín's posted sheet and goes to bed late.
entries.outcome: Knows her Friday and Sunday hours.

entries.what: Gets her chemistry progress report from Ms. Tolentino: a B.
entries.outcome: Decent grade but she knows the lab conclusions are weak.

entries.what: Checks her phone fund after her fourth paycheck and sees only about $95; going through the spending, it is mostly boba and snacks for friends.
entries.outcome: Resolves to rethink the boba runs.

entries.what: Works her Friday 4-9 shift at Taquería Colima taking orders next to Camila and Héctor, eating a quesadilla as her shift meal.
entries.outcome: Smooth shift and no tickets slow-walked.

entries.what: Rafael picks her up after the 9 p.m. close and drives her home.
entries.outcome: Gets home before bed.

entries.what: Does Saturday laundry at the card-only laundry room at Marisol Gardens.
entries.outcome: Laundry done and folded.

entries.what: Hangs out in the 'lab rats' chat with Karina and Eli and edits a TikTok-style video she never posts.
entries.outcome: Leaves the video unposted.

entries.what: Skips boba and has dinner with her mom.
entries.outcome: Keeps her cash.

entries.what: Takes the 22 bus to Calle Ortega for her Sunday 10-4 shift at Taquería Colima.
entries.outcome: Works a busy Sunday lunch rush.

entries.what: Hears from her mom that the Delgado Park harvest farmers market is packed after church, and the family pupusa stand is there.
entries.outcome: Misses it because of her shift.

entries.what: Karina texts after midnight asking if people are talking about her, and Dulce reassures her.
entries.outcome: Goes to sleep late.
